title: Agent Harness Profile 0.1 harness sidecar (harness.json)
description: Sidecar to a pure Oracle Agent Spec 26.3.1 agent.json. Six chapters: role, knowledge, tools, workflow, boundaries, model. Linked to agent.json by agent_ref (the Agent component id). Schema validation is necessary but not sufficient: the profile's lint rules (for example: an unclassified tool is a write tool; a write tool never has approval never; on_timeout is deny; requester_may_approve is false) are checked by the conformance runner. Requirement levels in property descriptions follow the profile: Required, Conditionally Required, Recommended, Opt-In.

$schema.description: Recommended. URI of this JSON Schema. When present it MUST be exactly this schema's $id.

agent_ref.description: Required. The id of the Agent Spec Agent component in agent.json that this sidecar describes.

role.description: Required. Chapter 1, role and voice: who the agent is, for whom it works and to whom it reports.

title.description: Required. Job title of the agent, for example Reception.

duties.description: Required. At least one duty, each a short plain sentence.

voice.description: Recommended. Tone and register the agent uses, for example formal, concise.

acts_on_behalf_of.description: Required. The organisation or person the agent acts for (use fictional names such as Example Co. in published examples).

reports_to.description: Required. Non-empty human role or principal id that receives the agent's reports and escalations.

locale.description: Recommended. BCP 47 language tag the agent writes in.

knowledge.description: Required (may be empty). Chapter 2, knowledge sources the agent may read. Writes happen only through tools.

name.description: Required. Short unique name of the source.

description.description: Recommended. What the source contains and how current it is.

access.description: Required. Access mode. Only read is defined in 0.1.

citation.description: Required. Whether answers drawn from this source must cite it.

tools.description: Required (may be empty). Chapter 3, system permissions: exactly one entry per Agent Spec tool in agent.json, matched by tool name, and no others.

triggers.description: Required. At least one way a run starts.

description.description: Required. Plain description of the trigger, for example: a new enquiry arrives from the website form.

steps.description: Required. Ordered work steps, each a short plain sentence.

on_failure.description: Required. What the agent does when a step fails: stop and report, or retry (idempotently) and then report.

handoffs.description: Recommended (may be empty). Situations in which the agent hands the task to a human or another agent.

to.description: Required. Human role, principal id or Agent Spec component id that receives the task.

when.description: Required. Plain sentence describing when the handoff happens.

may_do_alone.description: Required (may be empty). Things the agent may do without asking.

must_ask.description: Required (may be empty). Things the agent must ask a human about first.

never.description: Required (may be empty). Things the agent must never do. Where expressible, each SHOULD also appear as a forbid policy in policy.cedar.

escalate_when.description: Required (may be empty). Situations in which the agent stops and reports to role.reports_to.

separation_of_duties.description: Required. Who may approve. Kept outside the approval object so that approval stays a verbatim ACS approval section.

requester_may_approve.description: Required. Whether the requester of an action may approve it. MUST be false (lint rule harness.requester-may-approve); agent principals never approve.

dispatcher_may_approve.description: Required. Whether the human who dispatched (assigned) the task may approve the agent's actions in that task.

record_dispatcher_self_approval.description: Required. Whether a dispatcher approval is marked in the decision record (decided_by_dispatcher) and audit log. MUST be true when dispatcher_may_approve is true (lint rule harness.dispatcher-self-approval-recorded).

model.description: Required. Chapter 6, model requirements and budget. Capabilities only; model names MUST NOT appear in a recipe.

requirements.description: Required. What the deployer's model must support.

capabilities.description: Required. Capabilities the model must have.

min_context_tokens.description: Recommended. Minimum context window in tokens.

languages.description: Recommended. BCP 47 language tags the model must handle well.

monthly_tokens.description: Required. Token budget per calendar month. MUST be greater than 0 (lint rule harness.budget-positive).

on_exceed.description: Required. What happens when the budget is used up.

extensions.description: Opt-In. Extension data. Keys MUST be namespaced as <reverse-DNS or domain>/<name>, for example com.example/ticketing. Consumers MUST ignore extensions they do not understand; extensions MUST NOT relax any rule of the profile.

tool.description: Permission entry for one Agent Spec tool.

name.description: Required. Tool name exactly as in agent.json: ASCII letters, digits, _ and -, 1 to 64 characters (the intersection of OpenAI function names, Claude API tool names and the MCP tool-name guidance). Recipes SHOULD use snake_case, for example mail_send.

description.description: Opt-In. Note for reviewers on what the tool changes.

kind.description: Required. read or write. The declared kind takes effect only if classification.source is operator; otherwise the effective kind is write (fail closed).

approval.description: Required. When a human must approve a call: always, over_limit (only when the call exceeds limit; the runtime passes context.limit_exceeded to Cedar) or never. An effective write tool MUST NOT use never (lint rule harness.write-approval).

limit.description: Conditionally Required: an object when approval is over_limit (lint rule harness.limit-required); otherwise null or absent. The runtime sets the Cedar context attribute limit_exceeded to true when the call argument named by field is greater than max (false when the tool has no limit).

field.description: Required. Name of the tool argument compared against max.

max.description: Required. Largest value allowed without approval.

unit.description: Recommended. Unit of the field, for example an ISO 4217 currency code such as USD.

classification.description: Recommended. Who classified the tool. Absent means unclassified, which makes the tool a write tool.

source.description: Required. operator: the deployer or operator set kind and it takes effect. mcp_annotations: kind was only pre-filled from MCP annotations and is not confirmed; the effective kind is write. unclassified: nobody classified the tool; the effective kind is write.

mcp_annotations.description: Opt-In. MCP 2026-07-28 ToolAnnotations as received from the server. Untrusted hints; used only to suggest a classification.

recipient_binding.description: Opt-In. Free text describing how the targets of the tool (recipients, accounts, URLs) are bound, for example request_record: the recipient is taken from the stored request record, never from model output.

approval.description: Required. Approval configuration. Field names, types and value sets are those of the Microsoft Agent Control Specification (ACS) manifest approval section, package release 0.4.0-beta.1 (spec/schema/approval.schema.json), so this object can be copied into an ACS manifest unchanged. The profile adds requirements on top: default_resolver, timeout_seconds and on_timeout are required here, and on_timeout MUST be deny (lint rule harness.on-timeout-deny).

default_resolver.description: Required. Name of the resolver consulted by default. MUST be a key of resolvers whose type is human (lint rule harness.default-resolver).

timeout_seconds.description: Required. Maximum wait in seconds before on_timeout applies. A request whose timeout elapses becomes expired, which is treated as deny.

on_timeout.description: Required. ACS value set deny, allow, suspend. The profile requires deny.

fatigue_threshold.description: Recommended. Soft cap on approval requests per agent within fatigue_window_seconds.

fatigue_window_seconds.description: Recommended. Window in seconds across which the fatigue counter accumulates.

resolvers.description: Required. Map of resolver name to resolver descriptor, as in ACS. At least one resolver.

resolver.description: One approval resolver. As in ACS, type is the discriminator and additional keys are preserved verbatim (extension intended).

type.description: Required. Resolver type. The profile defines human: a human principal decides through one of the listed channels.

channels.description: Recommended for type human. Channels through which the human can decide.
